title: Generative AI in 2023: How It Works, Where It Lands
excerpt: Generative AI ya wuce daga bincike zuwa aiwatarwa a 2023. GPT-4, Claude 2, Llama 2, da Mistral sun nuna cewa large language models na iya sarrafa duba takardun shari'a, samar da code, da tattaunawar abokan ciniki a ingancin da ya dace da ɗan adam — wanda ya haifar da tambayoyin gaggawa na gudanarwa game da hallucination, zubewar bayanai, da bin ƙa'idoji a ayyukan kudi.
